subject: AtlasPay pilot — timing & budget
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@atlaspay.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasPay pilot — timing & budget

Hi Michael — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Goals we heard
- Validate fraud-reduction improvement for cross-border payouts (target: >= 20% false-positive reduction)
- Measure latency and cost for 1M messages/month pilot
- Integrate via Redwood API w/ token-level tracing for audit

Success criteria
- Pilot runs for 6 weeks with baseline comparison
- Key metrics: FP rate, mean latency, cost per 1k tokens

Stakeholders
- Michael Chen (Payments) — decision influence on product
- Jenna Ortiz (Procurement) — PO / procurement process
- IT / Security (SOC2 evidence) — security sign-off

Immediate next steps (from our side)
- I attached a first-pass SOW and pricing (Redwood-AtlasPay-SOW-v1.pdf). Please review for scope and suggest redlines.
- We can offer a time-limited pilot pricing tier (6-week pilot, up to 1M tokens) or a committed monthly plan — happy to run numbers after you confirm preference.
- Proposed pilot start: week of Jul 14 (flexible if procurement needs more time).

Can you confirm who should receive the SOW and whether procurement needs a different format (SOW + PO form, or DocuSign)?

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-next week if I don’t hear back.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Redwood-AtlasPay-SOW-v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@atlaspay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@atlaspay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay pilot — timing & budget

Thanks for the recap, Sergio — useful summary. I shared the SOW with Jenna in procurement and our security lead. A few quick notes: 

- Procurement is asking for a pricing matrix that includes a 6-week pilot option and a 3-month committed option (tiers + overage rates).
- Security wants evidence of SOC 2 (Type II) and data retention policy — can you point me to a short package we can pass along?
- Budget is not yet finalized; we expect a decision by end of Q2 but procurement timelines are tight.

Jenna — adding you to thread for procurement details / preferred PO flow.

Michael
Head of Payments, AtlasPay
michael.chen@atlaspay.com

Subject: Re: AtlasPay pilot — timing & budget

Quick follow-up as we hit the end of the quarter — wanted to check status and whether any priorities shifted on your side. Short answers are fine: 1) Is procurement still targeting an end-of-Q2 decision? 2) Is budget allocation confirmed or do you still need a PO to unlock funds?

If helpful, I can: 
- Fast-track an internal approval for a one-time pilot discount if procurement needs a buffer to sign before PO issuance.
- Flatten the SOW to a one-page summary for procurement / legal to accelerate review.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync with Jenna + Michael to walk pricing options and agree a final pilot scope. I’m free Thurs 26 Jun 10:00–12:00 PT or Fri 27 Jun 14:00–16:00 PT. Monica (CS) and Vivek (solutions) are looped so we can answer questions live.

Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@atlaspay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay pilot — timing & budget

Apologies for the delay — been a busy week on our end. Quick updates: 

- Procurement (Jenna) confirmed budget authorization pending PO. They prefer a 6-week pilot with the option to convert to a monthly commitment.
- Procurement requested a slightly revised pricing table that separates pilot discount and post-pilot committed rates; Jenna attached a short procurement requirements PDF for format and invoicing fields.
- Security reviewed the SOC2 link you provided (thanks) and asked one question about retention windows — they want the default retention/archival timeframe included in the SOW.

Jenna — can you confirm availability for a 30-min call Tue, Jul 1 at 11:00 AM PT (we prefer to lock times before vendor holidays)? If Tuesday works we’ll get a PO template over right after the call.

Sergio — thanks for the patient follow-up and for looping Monica & Vivek. If you can bring the revised SOW and a short pricing matrix to the call, we should be in good shape to sign the PO within 48–72 hours after.

Michael
Head of Payments, AtlasPay

Attachment: AtlasPay-procurement-req.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
